# McCoy Landscape Group

> Owner-operated hardscape design-build team serving West GTA, Ontario, Canada since 2001. 200+ completed projects across Oakville, Burlington, Mississauga, and Milton. Every install backed by a 3-year workmanship warranty (sink, level, and cracking replacement).

McCoy Landscape Group is owned by Alex Medeiros and Pieter Meeussen, two long-time crew members who purchased the company in 2024. Specializes in premium hardscape installations using concrete pavers and segmental wall block: paver patios, paver driveways, retaining walls, outdoor living spaces (pergolas, fire features, outdoor kitchens), and landscape lighting. Preferred manufacturers: Techo-Bloc, Unilock, Permacon. Serves homeowners across West GTA who want hardscape that is built once and stays level for decades.

## Contact

- Service area: West GTA, Ontario, Canada — Oakville, Burlington, Mississauga, Milton, and surrounding communities

## Services
- [Services hub](https://mccoylandscapegroup.com/services): All service categories with overviews and links
- [Paver Patios & Walkways](https://mccoylandscapegroup.com/services/paver-patios): Custom backyard patios, front entry walkways, side-yard runs, pool decks, multi-level step-down patios. Concrete pavers built for Ontario freeze–thaw — proper base depth, edge restraint, drainage. 3-year warranty.
- [Paver Driveways](https://mccoylandscapegroup.com/services/paver-driveways): Curb-appeal driveway installations in concrete paver, engineered for Ontario freeze–thaw cycles
- [Retaining Walls](https://mccoylandscapegroup.com/services/retaining-walls): Engineered structural and decorative retaining walls — segmental concrete block systems, integrated steps, tiered grade changes
- [Outdoor Living](https://mccoylandscapegroup.com/services/outdoor-living): Fire features (wood and gas), pergolas, outdoor kitchens, seating walls, full living-space scopes
- [Landscape Lighting](https://mccoylandscapegroup.com/services/landscape-lighting): Low-voltage path lighting, tree and architectural uplighting, deck and step lighting, whole-yard system design
- [Softscape](https://mccoylandscapegroup.com/services/softscape): Sod installation, garden bed design, planting, and mulch — paired with hardscape or on its own
